Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j

Interface LogDispatcher

All Known Implementing Classes:
UniversalDispatcher
public interface LogDispatcher
This interface defines the contract for classes that dispatch log entries to registered handlers.

  • Method Details

    • addLogHandler

      void addLogHandler(LogHandler handler)
      Adds a handler for log entry events. The handler will be invoked whenever a log entry is received.
      Parameters:
      handler - The log entry handler to be added.

    • removeLogHandler

      void removeLogHandler(LogHandler handler)
      Removes a previously added log entry handler. The handler will no longer be invoked for any log entries.
      Parameters:
      handler - The log entry handler to be removed.

    • setFilter

      void setFilter(LoggerNamePrefixFilter filter)
      Sets the LoggerNamePrefixFilter for log entry events.

      Only entries that pass the filter will be dispatched to handlers.

      Parameters:
      filter - The filter to be set for log entry events.

    • getFilter

      LoggerNamePrefixFilter getFilter()
      Get the LogFilter.
      Returns:
      the filter in use

    • getRootLevel

      LogLevel getRootLevel()
      Retrieves the root logging level for log entries. The root level determines the minimum severity of log entries that will be processed by the dispatcher.
      Returns:
      the current root logging level

    • setRootLevel

      void setRootLevel(LogLevel level)
      Sets the root logging level for log entries. Log entries with a level lower than the specified root level will not be dispatched to handlers.
      Parameters:
      level - the root logging level to set. Must not be null.

    • getLevel

      LogLevel getLevel(String prefix)
      Retrieves the log level associated with the specified logger name prefix.
      Parameters:
      prefix - The prefix of logger names for which the log level is being retrieved. Must not be null or empty.
      Returns:
      The LogLevel associated with the specified prefix, or null if no level is explicitly assigned to the prefix.

    • setLevel

      void setLevel(String prefix, LogLevel level)
      Sets the log level for log entries matching the specified name prefix.
      Parameters:
      prefix - The prefix of logger names for which the log level should be set.
      level - The log level to be assigned to the loggers matching the specified prefix.

    • getLogHandlers

      SequencedCollection<LogHandler> getLogHandlers()
      Get the registered log entry handlers. Note that implementations usually hold weak references to the handlers, so unused handlers may already have been removed from the list.
      Returns:
      collection containing the registered log entry handlers
